# `larian-formats`

`larian-formats` is a Rust library for parsing Baldur's Gate 3 mod files. Most of the functionality
uses [`LSLib`](https://github.com/Norbyte/lslib) as guidance for how the various file formats work.

## Documentation

API documentation can be found at https://docs.rs/larian-formats.

## Wrappers

Wrapper libraries are published for [Python](https://pypi.org/project/larian-formats/) and [WASM](https://www.npmjs.com/package/larian-formats-wasm).
